locator: Figure 1 and Table 1, sodium and potassium baths
preparation: Washed rainbow-trout erythrocytes after transfer from 320 to 215 mOsm/kg water in ouabain. Changes are from initial swelling to 60 minutes in the hypotonic bath.
solute_unit: micromol per g dry cell solids
water_unit: g water per g dry cell solids
values: Pairs are mean and SEM. Positive values are gains by the cell.
mapping: At isosmotic endpoints with the same bath, the ideal change in water mass per g dry solids is the measured change in micromoles of particles per g dry solids divided by the bath value in micromoles per g water. This reproduces the paper's conditional calculation. The table supplies both an aggregate and individual ion and taurine means.
omission: The choline row lacks a total osmole change. Species-specific net changes include all pathways in each condition.
